body: In `get_project_metadata("files_panel", "show_files_panel", "")` the last parameter sets the default return value to `""`. From my testing the `if` is executed only when the old setting is present.

Right, in that case  `es->get_project_metadata("files_panel", "show_files_panel", Variant()) != Variant()`.
I'm not sure why string is being used here.

I guess I did it because the data is stored as text but that doesn't make sense. I previously did this the same way in the shader editor rework for deprecating `recent_files/scripts` in `ScriptEditorPlugin::get_window_layout`, should I also change it to use `Variant()`?
Yeah, I think that one should also be `Variant()`.
Nevermind, that way the old setting will never be removed if it stores the default...
